After the Base chain set up independently, OP indeed suffered a setback, dropping nearly 40% in a month; this feeling is quite familiar to veteran investors.

Although the ZK upgrade and interoperability mentioned in the 2026 roadmap sound appealing, coupled with 50% of sorter revenue being used for token buybacks, it genuinely aims to boost the secondary market. However, in today's environment, people are more concerned about the ecosystem's ability to attract capital; with Base's exit, the narrative cohesion of Superchain is indeed damaged. This phase is a classic painful transition period for projects; the benefits are long-term, while in the short-term, it depends on whether the 50% buyback can withstand the selling pressure.
